<!-- Why this change, in a sentence or two. The title is the squash commit's subject. -->

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit: `type(scope): summary`, imperative and lowercase, no trailing period.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, for the DCO check).
- [ ] Code that handles money, keys or quota has Vitest tests beside it (AGENTS.md); everything else passes lint, format, typecheck and a manual check.
- [ ] If this ships, starts, drops or changes something on the public roadmap, `apps/web/src/content/roadmap.ts` and its `updated` date are updated here.
